prompt: Streaming platforms have largely replaced scheduled television and, for many people, trips to the cinema. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this change.
essay:
In recent years, the streaming platforms have become very popular and many people do not watch the normal television or go to the cinema anymore. This essay will look at the advantages and the disadvantages of this change.

There are several advantages of the streaming. The first advantage is the convenience. People can watch what they want, when they want, and they do not need to wait for a special time or day. This is very convenient for the busy people who work late. The second advantage is the price. A monthly subscription is much cheaper than the cinema tickets, especially for a family. Furthermore, there is a huge amount of the content available, so people can watch the things from the different countries which they could not watch before.

However, this change has the disadvantages too. Firstly, going to the cinema is a social activity and watching alone at home is not the same. Many cinemas are closing down and this is sad for the community. Secondly, people are watching too much because of the streaming, and some of them spend all the weekend on the sofa, which is not healthy. Also, there are too many platforms now and each one need a separate subscription, so in the end it is not so cheap like before.

In conclusion, the streaming has changed the way we watch the films and the television. It has the advantages like the convenience and the price, and also the disadvantages like the social problems and the health. People should use it in a balanced way.
title: Streaming instead of schedules and cinemas
